name: CAT vs DE Pairs Analysis
description: Multi-dimensional pairs analysis of Caterpillar (CAT) vs Deere & Co (DE). Covers: (1) Normalized price performance indexed to 100, (2) 60-day rolling Pearson correlation of daily returns with summary stats, (3) Price ratio with rolling mean, ±1 std bands, and z-score for mean-reversion signals, (4) Rolling 252-day return spread as relative performance indicator.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CAT vs DE — PAIRS ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Dimensions:
#   1. Normalized Price Performance (indexed to 100)
#   2. 60-day Rolling Correlation of daily returns
#   3. Price Ratio with rolling mean, ±1 std band, and z-score
#   4. Rolling 252-day Return Spread (CAT minus DE)
#
# Assets: CAT-Stocks, DE-Stocks | Timeframe: Daily
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# Load DE as reference
de_o, de_h, de_l, de_c, de_v, de_vw, de_n = reference_stocks(ticker='DE')()
de_close = ffill(de_c)

bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# 1. NORMALIZED PRICE PERFORMANCE (indexed to 100)
# =============================================================================
# First close as base via cumulative first
cat_first = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.First)(close)
de_first = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.First)(de_close)

cat_norm = close / cat_first * 100
de_norm = de_close / de_first * 100

# Cross-sectional lines: both normalized series on one chart
cs_lines(
    title='Normalized Price Performance (Indexed to 100)',
    category='1. Price Performance',
    y_axis_label='Indexed Price',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0
)(bar_ts, cat_norm)

# =============================================================================
# 2. ROLLING CORRELATION (60-day Pearson on daily returns)
# =============================================================================
cat_ret = returns(period=1)(close)
de_ret = returns(period=1)(de_close)

corr_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=cat_ret, y=de_ret)

xy_lines(
    title='60-Day Rolling Correlation (CAT vs DE Daily Returns)',
    category='2. Rolling Correlation',
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60d Rolling Correlation', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='0')
    ])
)(bar_ts, corr_60d)

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Correlation Statistics',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['60d Correlation'],
        col_headers=['Mean', 'Min', 'Max', 'Current'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='2. Rolling Correlation'
)(corr_60d, corr_60d, corr_60d, corr_60d)

# =============================================================================
# 3. PRICE RATIO & Z-SCORE (Mean Reversion Panel)
# =============================================================================
ratio = close / de_close

# Rolling 60-day mean and std of the ratio
ratio_mean = ma(period=60)(ratio)
ratio_std = stddev(period=60)(ratio)

# ±1 std bands
ratio_upper = ratio_mean + ratio_std
ratio_lower = ratio_mean - ratio_std

# Z-score of ratio (rolling 60-day)
ratio_zscore = zscore(window=60)(ratio)

# Ratio chart with mean and bands
xy_lines(
    title='CAT/DE Price Ratio with 60d Mean ± 1σ Bands',
    category='3. Mean Reversion',
    y_axis_label='Price Ratio (CAT / DE)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='CAT/DE Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60d Mean', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='+1σ', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='-1σ', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ])
)(bar_ts, ratio, ratio_mean, ratio_upper, ratio_lower)

# Z-score chart
xy_lines(
    title='CAT/DE Ratio Z-Score (60-Day Rolling)',
    category='3. Mean Reversion',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=2, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='+2σ'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2, color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='-2σ'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid, title='0')
    ])
)(bar_ts, ratio_zscore)

# Ratio summary stats
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Price Ratio Statistics',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=6,
        row_headers=['CAT/DE Ratio'],
        col_headers=['Current', 'Mean', 'Std', 'Z-Score', 'Min', 'Max'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=5, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='3. Mean Reversion'
)(ratio, ratio, ratio, ratio_zscore, ratio, ratio)

# =============================================================================
# 4. RELATIVE VALUATION SPREAD (Rolling 252-day return spread)
# =============================================================================
cat_1y = (close - (close >> 252)) / (close >> 252)
de_1y = (de_close - (de_close >> 252)) / (de_close >> 252)

# Spread: positive = CAT outperforming DE
return_spread = cat_1y - de_1y

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 252-Day Return Spread (CAT minus DE)',
    category='4. Relative Performance',
    area=True,
    y_axis_label='Return Spread',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='CAT minus DE (1Y Rolling)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid, title='0%')
    ])
)(bar_ts, return_spread)
